s: Din hattoqea letok habbor ubo h' seipim: shemiat qol shopar tzerika lihyot belo irbub qol acher kelal, abal im shama haqqol beirbubeya — lo yatza. Lepikak, haomed betok chabit gedola, o bebor, o bedut dehaynu binyan sherubbo tachat haqqarqa (abal im rubbo lemala min haqqarqa ap al pi shemmiqtzato betok haqqarqa — dino kebayit), veken haomed betok hammeara vetoqea veshameu acherim mibbachutz, im barur lahem sheshshameu qol shopar — yatzeu, veim lav — lo yatzeu, lepi shehaqqol mitbalbel behebel habbor vehaddut qodem sheyyatza lachutz veepshar shello shameu ella qol habara. Vetob lehachamir sheap shebbarur lo sheqqol shopar shama — lo yismok al beqiuto, veyachazor veyishma shenit hatteqiot shello min hattoqea babbor, abal lo yebarek shenit, ella im ken barur lo sheshshama qol habara, dispeq berakot lehaqel:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Beotam haomedim chutz labbor, abal hattoqea atzmo veken otam haomedim immo babbor — yatzeu, shebbevadday qol shopar shameu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bebor vedut umeara, abal bechabit gedola shehabaratah gedola, ap hattoqea vehaomedim immo betokah epshar sheyyishmeu qol habara, lepikak im barur lahem sheshshameu qol shopar — yatzeu, veim lav — lo yatzeu:

Im hitchil litqoa babbor veala chutz labbor vegamar et hatteqia shehitchil babbor — yatza yede chobato, shekkol mah sheshshama ben keshehaya bipnim ben keshehaya bachutz haya bevadday qol shopar. Veim kesheala mehabbor hotzi oznayv chutz labbor qodem shehotzi hashshopar lachutz — lo yatza, ella im ken barur lo shebbarega hahi shama qol shopar. Ulepi shei epshar letzamtzem sheyyotzi haoznayim vehashshopar keechad, laken tob sheyyotzi hashshopar techilla qodem laoznayim, deaz bevadday yishma qol shopar, kevan shehashshopar hu bachutz bemaqom sheen sham qol habara. Veotam shehayu omedim immo babbor beshaa shehitchil litqoa sham, ap al pi shello yatzeu immo mehabbor, ap al pi ken hem yotzeim batteqiot, diksheadam babbor vehashshopar chutz labbor bevadday shomea qol hashshopar velo qol habara kemo shennitbaer:

Hashshomea miqtzat teqiat qol shopar umiqtzat qol habara, kegon shehaya omed chutz labbor vehattoqea hitchil litqoa babbor ubeemtza hatteqia yatza chutz labbor ugemarah sham, veken hashshomea miqtzat teqia shello bechiyyub dehaynu qodem or hayyom umiqtzatah achar or hayyom, veken haomer lemi shemmitasseq bitqiot belo kavvana lehotzi shum adam bitqiato ubeemtza hatteqia amar lo kavven lehotzieni vetaqa umashak bah shiur teqia, kol ellu kevan shemmiqtzat hatteqia hu shello ketiqnah ap al pi shebbemiqtzatah shehi ketiqnah yesh bah shiur teqia sheyyitbaer besiman tq"tz — lo yatza yede chobato, lepi shekkol teqia tzerika shettehe bekashrut mittechillatah vead sopah apillu hi arukka harbeh:

Hattoqea bebet hakkeneset veyesh omedim bachutz rachoq qetzat mibbet hakkeneset, im en barur lahem sheshshameu qol shopar — tzerikim lishmoa hatteqiot shenit, lepi sheepshar sheshshameu qol habara, abal im nireh lahem barur sheqqol shopar shameu — enam tzerikim lehachamir al atzman velishmoa shenit:
